title: Director at IT Services Firm Expects Oracle Business to Grow 25% in 2026, Driven by OCI and AI Demand
expert: Practice director at an IT services firm and Oracle partner (advisory, implementation, resale); clients ~80% SMB/mid-market, ~20% large enterprise
verdict: A mid-market Oracle partner's Oracle activity grew 25% y/y in Sep–Nov and OCI demand rose 5% q/q, but OCI AI demand exceeds available capacity and is delaying project starts.

IaaS growth vs consensus: 🟢 **Oracle activity +25% y/y in Sep–Nov; OCI demand +5% vs Jun–Aug** (first-hand); first read from this practice. → Tenet 1 (OCI RPO conversion) ↑
🔴 **OCI AI demand exceeds available capacity, delaying project starts and cutting scope** vs UBS checks of no systemic delays (SB #66105): **conflicting**. → Tenet 4 (build-out on time) ↓
🟢 **Production AI use rose from about 10% to 20% of clients** Jun–Aug → Sep–Nov (first-hand); first read.
Pricing & margins: 🟡 **Average price increases no more than 2% y/y** (estimate) vs Deutsche Bank checks of 10–40% cloud-service increases (SB #63354): **conflicting**. → Tenet 4 (margins) ↓
Competition & share: 🔴 **Oracle most often loses to Microsoft in cloud; lost enterprise HCM deals to Workday despite a cheaper bid**, while winning SAP on-prem migrations; conflicts with UBS relay of Dell cutting Workday for Fusion (SB #67339). → Tenet 5 (apps & database) ↓

characterization_changed: Characterization changed from Very Positive: practice growth is strong (+25% y/y) but the expert also reports enterprise HCM losses to Workday, Oracle most often losing to Microsoft in cloud, capacity delays and price increases of no more than 2%.
changes: Capacity: OCI AI demand exceeding capacity and delaying starts vs UBS checks with 23 customers/partners showing no systemic delays (SB #66105, 2026-11-04): **conflicting**.
Pricing: increases of no more than 2% y/y vs Deutsche Bank checks of 10–40% on cloud services (SB #63354, 2026-10-19): **conflicting**.
HCM competition: losses to Workday in enterprise HCM vs UBS partner relay that Dell consolidated on Fusion and cut Workday (SB #67339, 2026-11-04): **conflicting**.
First read on share of partner clients running AI in production (about 10% → 20%).
thesis_impact: Tenet 1 (OCI RPO conversion): ↑ — practice Oracle activity +25% y/y, OCI demand +5% q/q and pipeline above expectations.
Tenet 4 (build-out on time / margins): ↓ — demand exceeds capacity with project delays and scope cuts; price increases of no more than 2%.
Tenet 5 (apps & database): ↓ slight — enterprise HCM losses to Workday and cloud losses to Microsoft, partly offset by SAP migration wins.
